item.title: CANCEL Definition & Meaning - Merriam-Webster
item.description: To cancel someone is to stop supporting them or their work. This means no longer reading what they write, listening to or watching what they create, or enjoying what they produce.

item.title: Cancel - definition of cancel by The Free Dictionary
item.description: To decide or announce that (a planned or scheduled event) will not take place, especially with no intention of holding it at a later time: cancel a picnic; cancel a soccer game.

item.title: Cancelled or Canceled - Which is Correct? | Merriam-Webster
item.description: While both canceled and cancelled are acceptable for the past tense of cancel, the version with one L is more common in American English, and the version with two L's is more common in British English.

item.title: CANCEL Definition & Meaning | Dictionary.com
item.description: CANCEL definition: to make void, as a contract or other obligation; annul: to cancel a magazine subscription. See examples of cancel used in a sentence.

item.title: CANCEL | English meaning - Cambridge Dictionary
item.description: CANCEL definition: 1. to decide that an organized event will not happen, or to stop an order for goods or services…. Learn more.

item.title: Cancel: Definition, Meaning, and Examples - usdictionary.com
item.description: The word "cancel" refers to the act of stopping something from proceeding, invalidating it, or countering its effects. Its definitions cover both concrete and abstract applications, from practical actions to symbolic gestures.

item.title: Cancell or Cancel? The Correct Spelling Explained Simply
item.description: Cancell or cancel explained clearly. Learn the correct spelling, British vs American rules, examples, FAQs, and expert usage advice.

item.title: What Does cancel Mean? Definition & Examples | Dictionary.net
item.description: Learn what cancel means with clear definitions, pronunciation, synonyms, and real-world examples. Simple explanations to help you use cancel correctly.

item.title: Cancel - Definition, Meaning & Synonyms | Vocabulary.com
item.description: To cancel means to call off or postpone indefinitely. Which is probably what you would do if the hotel you were planning to stay in has an infestation of bedbugs.

item.title: cancel - WordReference.com Dictionary of English
item.description: Cancel, delete, erase, obliterate indicate that something is no longer to be considered usable or in force. To cancel is to cross something out by stamping a mark over it, drawing lines through it, or the like: to cancel a stamp, a word.
